crossRefs.note: How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?
No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him, and I will raise him up in the last day.
But if I do them, though you don’t believe me, believe the works, that you may know and believe that the Father is in…
They don’t know, neither do they consider: for he has shut their eyes, that they can’t see; and their hearts, that they…
having eyes full of adultery, and who can’t cease from sin; enticing unsettled souls; having a heart trained in greed…
He said, “Go, and tell this people, ‘You hear indeed, but don’t understand. You see indeed, but don’t perceive.’
Make the heart of this people fat. Make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, hear with…
